title: Blimey song (songs/<name>.yaml)
description: One song: the channel-2 Program Change that selects it and the cues its channel-2 notes fire. The song's name is its file name. Fixture, group and colour names, and programs shared by two songs, are checked by the engine at load.

program.description: Program Change value on channel 2, 0-127, unique across songs.

bpm.description: Tempo for beat and bar durations when no MIDI clock arrives. Defaults to 120.

time_signature.description: Beats per bar over the note value, e.g. 4/4 or 6/8. A beat is a quarter note, so a bar of 6/8 is 3 beats. Defaults to 4/4.

safe_look.description: What panic (channel 16, note 127) shows. Without it, panic goes dark.

pattern.description: Envelope hits on the beats of a 1-4 bar loop. The loop starts on the bar line after note-on (at once if the note is within one MIDI clock tick after a bar line) and repeats until note-off, then fades out over release.

target.description: Either fixture or group → dimmer: the level scales their intensity, dark between hits. Or fixture or group → look settings: the level is how much of that look shows.

at.description: Beat of the pattern, from 1, in quarter beats: 1, 2.5, 3.75. The engine checks it falls within the length.

length.description: In beats or bars, at most the pattern's length.

swell.description: A look reached along a curve over a duration from note-on, scaled by velocity, then held; fades out from note-off.

curve.description: How much of the target shows along the duration, 0-1. Defaults to ramp-up.

points.description: [time, level] pairs, both 0-1, times rising, joined by straight lines.

scene.description: A fixed look. Fades in from note-on, scaled by velocity; fades out from note-off.

duration.description: A number then a unit: 500ms, 2s, 0.5 beats, 4 bars. Beats and bars follow the MIDI clock, or the song's bpm without one. Fades and releases default to 0 (instant).

values.description: Fixture or group name → look settings, applied in order: a later entry wins on shared fixtures.
